answer: Make identity costly and reputation slow-earned. Each agent bonds a refundable stake to one persistent key, then must accrue peer-attested work over weeks, like tending a garden rather than flipping a switch. A public attestation ledger acts as a lantern: it lights up hollow, freshly minted keys that posted stake but carry no history, so a sybil pays full stake per identity yet reaps nothing until it has genuinely contributed. Forging a crowd means funding and slowly maturing each fake in parallel, which collapses the economics.
